# Mismatches under an exact prefix remain exercised through the ordinary known
# failure ledger, but are classified as unsupported dependency syntax rather
# than renderer conformance failures. Passing assertions under the same prefix
# remain active.

css-align/parsing/gap-invalid.html|reason=pinned Lightning CSS accepts negative gap values that CSS Box Alignment rejects; the typed renderer boundary discards them without adding a second parser
css-align/parsing/row-gap-invalid.html|reason=pinned Lightning CSS accepts negative gap values that CSS Box Alignment rejects; the typed renderer boundary discards them without adding a second parser

css-align/parsing/justify-items-valid.html|reason=pinned Lightning CSS does not represent the bare legacy justify-items value; html-style does not implement a second CSS parser
css-align/parsing/place-items-computed.html|reason=pinned Lightning CSS does not represent the bare legacy justify-items component; html-style does not implement a second CSS parser
css-align/parsing/place-items-valid.html|reason=pinned Lightning CSS does not represent the bare legacy justify-items component; html-style does not implement a second CSS parser
css-color/|reason=modern color syntax not represented reliably by pinned Lightning CSS; html-style does not implement a second CSS parser
css-flexbox/|reason=remaining intrinsic flex-basis keywords, nonnegative length grammar, and modern calc functions are not represented reliably by pinned Lightning CSS; the renderer consumes only typed values and does not implement a second CSS parser
css-grid/|reason=remaining Grid Level 2, subgrid, and grammar divergences are not represented reliably by pinned Lightning CSS; html-style consumes only typed values and does not implement a second CSS parser
css-lists/parsing/list-style-type-invalid.html|reason=pinned Lightning CSS accepts symbols() arities that CSS Counter Styles rejects; unsupported marker algorithms are discarded at the typed renderer boundary without adding a second parser
css-logical/|reason=remaining negative logical size and border-width grammar mismatches are accepted by pinned Lightning CSS; html-style discards invalid typed values at its boundary and does not implement a second CSS parser
css-tables/parsing/border-spacing-invalid.html|reason=pinned Lightning CSS accepts negative and unitless border-spacing lengths; the typed renderer boundary discards negative values without adding a second parser
css-text/|reason=remaining modern text-transform and word-break values, advanced calc functions, legacy text-justify aliasing, and unitless length validation are not represented reliably by pinned Lightning CSS; unsupported typed values are discarded without adding a second parser
css-masking/|reason=CSS clipping and masking are not implemented by the style, layout, or paint pipeline
css-transforms/|reason=CSS transforms are intentionally outside the document renderer scope and no transformed paint or interaction geometry is implemented
css-inline/parsing/vertical-align-|reason=CSS Inline Level 3 vertical-align grammar is not exposed by pinned Lightning CSS; unsupported values are not represented downstream
css-overflow/parsing/text-overflow-|reason=custom text-overflow string markers are not exposed by pinned Lightning CSS; clip and ellipsis remain active and are rendered

css-backgrounds/parsing/background-size|reason=background image sizing is not implemented
css-backgrounds/parsing/background-computed.html|reason=the mismatches exercise unimplemented background clipping layers
css-backgrounds/parsing/background-valid.html|reason=the mismatches exercise unimplemented background clipping values
css-backgrounds/parsing/border-radius|reason=remaining parsing and serialization mismatches belong to the pinned LightningCSS grammar
css-backgrounds/parsing/webkit-border-radius|reason=remaining prefixed parsing and serialization mismatches belong to the pinned LightningCSS grammar
css-backgrounds/parsing/border-image|reason=border images are not implemented
css-backgrounds/parsing/box-shadow|reason=box shadow painting is not implemented
filter-effects/|reason=filter and backdrop-filter require an unimplemented offscreen paint and compositing pipeline
css-transitions/|reason=the noninteractive renderer has no animation clock, interpolated style state, or frame-driven restyling
css-animations/|reason=the noninteractive renderer has no animation clock, keyframe state, or frame-driven restyling
